name: @chankov/agent-fleet
description: Subagent orchestration for the pi coding agent — a thin dispatcher runs parallel subagents under a verification contract, keeping their output out of its context window. Multi-agent fleets, 15 personas, skills, herdr panes, peer coms, Hermes desktop.
